description: Words missed during the attentional blink and rated at zero visibility still evoked strong, long-lasting brain potentials up to 300 ms after presentation (Sergent et al. 2005, as reported by Sergent and Rees).
limitations: Reported secondhand in a commentary. The original study is not read here.

sources.quote: elicited strong, long-lasting brain potentials up to 300 msecs after they had been presented
